name: Vintage Cartoon
traits: bouncy rubber-hose limbs and pie-cut eyes
faded early colour or sepia-toned monochrome
aged film print marks: dust, scratches, flicker, gate weave
painted watercolour backgrounds behind flat inked figures
bestFor: short loops with a strong rhythm
suits: food, drink, cleaning, household and heritage products; cheerful, nostalgic, mischievous brands
stylePara: An early sound-era cartoon print: characters drawn with round heads, pie-cut eyes, white four-finger gloves and bendy rubber-hose arms and legs, inked in a bold even black line and filled with flat paint; colour faded to a narrow two-strip palette of salmon reds, teal greens and creamy ochres, or warm sepia monochrome; backgrounds are soft watercolour plates behind the crisp inked figures; the whole image carries film age: fine grain, dust specks, a few vertical scratches, slight exposure flicker and a soft rounded vignette in a 4:3 feel inside the vertical frame.

rendering.line: bold uniform black ink line, perfectly closed shapes, simple circles and curves; no line weight variation
rendering.shading: flat fills with almost no shadow; at most a simple drop shadow on the floor
rendering.colour: faded two-strip palette (salmon, teal, cream, black) or sepia monochrome; the product kept recognisable in a faded version of its colours
rendering.texture: film grain, dust, scratches, light leaks at the edges, exposure flicker, slight gate weave
rendering.lighting: flat and even, like a cel lit on a camera stand; vignette darkens the corners

motion: Animated on ones and twos with springy rubber-hose bounce: characters idle in a constant rhythmic bob, limbs swing in smooth arcs without elbows, strong squash and stretch on every step; objects come alive and dance to the beat; the print jitters slightly in the gate.
camera: Static stage-like framing, characters playing to the front as on a stage; trucking moves in and out on the flat background; iris-in and iris-out to open and close; no perspective-changing moves.
avoid: clean sharp HD with no film wear
realistic anatomy with elbows and knees
title cards or lettering burned into the print
sheets: A model sheet in the period manner: front, three-quarter, side and two action poses in black line on a cream ground, with the rubber-hose limbs and glove shape fixed; then one coloured version in the faded palette; the product redrawn as a simple cartoon object in its faded colours.
risk: Seedance keeps the film wear but drifts back to modern clean colour and adds elbows and realistic hands, and it may write fake title cards into the scratched print; repeat 'faded two-strip palette, rubber-hose limbs without elbows, constant bouncing rhythm' and 'no lettering'. The pie-cut eyes and gloves can read as a specific old character; keep the woman a new design with her own bun and orange top.

example.prompt: Early sound-era cartoon still on aged film: a rubber-hose woman in her thirties with a round head, pie-cut eyes, a dark bun and an orange top in faded salmon-orange, bold black ink line, holds up a small faded-green glass bottle with a yellow cap; a sunny kitchen painted as a soft watercolour plate, a droopy cartoon fern on the windowsill; two-strip faded palette, film grain, dust and scratches, soft vignette. Vertical 9:16. No text.
